title: test_user_authentication_login_logout_flow
description: Verify that users can login using NIK or email with correct password, are redirected to the appropriate role dashboard, see an error alert on invalid credentials, and can logout successfully returning to the login page.

title: test_pengajuan_kerjasama_publik_submission_validation
description: Verify that a public partner can submit a new cooperation proposal by filling all required fields and uploading a PDF proposal, and that submission confirmation is shown; also verify validation errors appear when required data is incomplete.

title: test_kelola_dokumen_kerjasama_create_edit_submit
description: Verify that internal unit users can add new cooperation documents with required details and scanned PDF, save as draft, edit draft documents, update attachments, submit documents to leadership, and that documents with non-draft status cannot be edited.

title: test_validasi_pengesahan_pimpinan_review_approve_reject
description: Verify that leadership users can review incoming partnership submissions, approve or request revisions with notes, reject submissions with reasons, and see the submission status updated accordingly.

title: test_subsistem_master_data_crud_and_send_access
description: Verify that admin users can perform CRUD operations on users, roles, cooperation types, partners, units, and classifications, and can filter partners without accounts and send login access credentials successfully.
